language.saveFailed: Could not save your language preference

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: This part of the app hit an unexpected error. The error has been reported.

access.pausedBody: The team inbox is not available right now. Your WhatsApp number stays linked and new messages are still received. Ask the person who looks after this app to check it.
access.autoCheck: This page checks again every minute and opens the inbox when it is available.

upgrade.agents: Need more AI agents? EzyChat Enterprise has one AI agent for each WhatsApp number.
upgrade.numbers: Need more WhatsApp numbers? EzyChat Enterprise links several numbers to one team inbox.
upgrade.about: More WhatsApp numbers and AI agents, with support from Anchor Sprint.

whatsappLink.title: What is a linked device?
whatsappLink.body: EzyChat links to your WhatsApp like WhatsApp Web. Your phone keeps the number; open WhatsApp on it at least every 14 days.

aiConnection.title: Why connect an AI?
aiConnection.body: EzyChat has no AI of its own. Sign in with ChatGPT (easiest) or use an API key; that service bills you.

apiKey.title: What is an API key?
apiKey.body: A secret code that lets EzyChat use OpenAI on your account. OpenAI bills you for what the AI uses.
apiKey.step2: Billing: add a card or credit.
apiKey.step3: API keys → Create new secret key.
apiKey.step4: Copy the key (sk-…) and paste it here.

claudeKey.title: What is a Claude API key?
claudeKey.body: A secret code that lets EzyChat use Claude on your account. Anthropic bills you for what the AI uses.
claudeKey.step4: Copy the key (sk-ant-…) and paste it here.

aiModel.title: What is a model?
aiModel.body: The version of the AI. Bigger is smarter but slower and costs more. Keep the recommended one.

businessContext.title: What is Business context?
businessContext.body: What the AI knows: products, prices, hours, delivery, FAQs. It answers only from this, so keep it up to date.

instructions.title: What is the role?
instructions.body: How the AI behaves: tone, language, what to ask. Facts like prices go in Business context.

handoff.title: What is a hand-over?
handoff.body: The AI stops and passes the chat to your team, who get a notification. These rules say when, e.g. complaints or refunds.

tryIt.title: What is Try it?
tryIt.body: A practice chat to see how the AI would answer. Nothing is sent to WhatsApp.

voice.title: What is voice transcription?
voice.body: Turns voice notes into text. On this computer: free and private. Cloud: faster, uses your OpenAI key.

tunnel.title: What is phone access?
tunnel.body: A secure web address (free, through Cloudflare) so your team can open the inbox on their phones. This computer must stay on.

lan.title: What is LAN access?
lan.body: Phones on the same Wi-Fi can open the inbox. Not encrypted: turn it on only on a network you trust.

mcp.title: What is AI assistant access?
mcp.body: Lets Claude or ChatGPT read your inbox to summarise chats or improve your AI agent. Off until you turn it on.

accessToken.title: What is an access token?
accessToken.body: A secret code for developer tools to use your inbox. claude.ai and ChatGPT do not need one.

connectors.title: What is a connector?
connectors.body: Lets your AI agent use another app, for example check Google Calendar and book appointments.
